outputs.explanation: This is a deconvoluted mass spectrum (a line/intensity trace), not a bar chart of averaged data. Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Same as panel A: a raw mass spectrum trace, exempt as a line plot.

Bar chart showing the proportion (%) of a protein population bound to specific numbers of metal atoms, derived directly from a single native MS measurement. There are no error bars, indicating these are single-experiment percentages rather than averages across replicates, so there are no underlying individual data points to overlay.

Bar chart of chemical shift perturbation (CSP) per residue at three distinct titration points (0.4, 1.0, 2 equivalents). Each bar is a single NMR measurement per residue/condition, not an average of replicates, and no error bars are shown, so there is no underlying replicate spread to display as individual points.
